messages:
Lina Park: quick follow-up from the last postmortem: we need concrete owners for rollout guardrails (auto-rollback, blast-radius defaults, quarantine). I'll list actions; please ack and claim.
Noah Green: ack. i'll take the auto-rollback test harness + CI gating.
Lina Park: Action 1 — auto-rollback harness (deterministic canary sim + chaos path). owner: @Noah. ETA: 10d. priority: P0.
Ibrahim M.: i'll pick up flag scoping and default rollout sizes. suggestion: new public flags start at 0.1% for 24h -> 1% -> 5% over 72h; internal starts 5%. Also add per-flag emergency_quarantine boolean.
Ava - SRE: runbook change: when auto-rollback or quarantine occurs, page the owner + oncall and automatically open an incident card with initial triage. I'll add the step and schedule a tabletop.
Lina Park: Action 2 — emergency_quarantine API + CLI + ACLs. owner: @Ibrahim. ETA: 12d.
Noah Green: for the harness i'll include a small YAML config to vary sample_rate + threshold and assert rollback_action executed. sample: ```yaml
canary:
  sample_rate: 0.005
  monitor: [error_rate]
  threshold: 0.02
  rollback: quarantine_flag
```
Maria Chen: Action 3 — rollout telemetry: per-flag control vs treatment metrics at 30s granularity + an anomaly hook. owner: @Maria. ETA: 3w.
Ibrahim M.: Action 4 — default rollout policy PR + migration plan. owner: @Ibrahim. ETA: 6d.
Ava - SRE: Action 5 — incident-pattern detector: surface when 3+ similar rollouts in 90d and recommend guardrail changes. owner: @Ava. ETA: 30d.
Lina Park: summary owners: Noah (harness + CI), Ibrahim (quarantine API + rollout defaults), Maria (telemetry), Ava (runbooks + pattern detector). please post PR links and commit SHAs here. weekly sync Friday 09:00 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy a1b2c3 -> staging by @Noah succeeded :white_check_mark:
Noah Green: starting branch `guardrails/auto-rollback-harness`. will update later with PR.
Lina Park: thanks all. if blockers, DM me. :thumbsup:
